spoken: runbook for a compromised credential, first disable the account in okta and revoke all active sessions, then check cloud trail for any api calls made with the user's access keys in the last twenty four hours, if you see anything unusual rotate the keys and open an incident in pager duty, after that pull the endpoint logs from crowd strike for the user's laptop and look for any new scheduled tasks or powershell activity, finally notify the manager and the security channel in slack
intended: Runbook for a compromised credential. First, disable the account in Okta and revoke all active sessions. Then check CloudTrail for any API calls made with the user's access keys in the last 24 hours. If you see anything unusual, rotate the keys and open an incident in PagerDuty. After that, pull the endpoint logs from CrowdStrike for the user's laptop and look for any new scheduled tasks or PowerShell activity. Finally, notify the manager and the security channel in Slack.

spoken: hi lukas, thanks for the patience on the leaderboard issue, so the root cause was that our cache layer in front of postgres was using a key that didn't include the season id, which meant that players saw last season's rankings after the reset, i've added the season id to the key and flushed memcached, and i also wrote a unit test with pytest that fails if the key is missing it, the fix is live on the staging server and i'll promote it to production tonight once the load test finishes, let me know if anyone still sees stale data tomorrow
intended: Hi Lukas, thanks for the patience on the leaderboard issue. The root cause was that our cache layer in front of Postgres was using a key that didn't include the season ID, which meant that players saw last season's rankings after the reset. I've added the season ID to the key and flushed Memcached, and I also wrote a unit test with pytest that fails if the key is missing it. The fix is live on the staging server, and I'll promote it to production tonight once the load test finishes. Let me know if anyone still sees stale data tomorrow.
